title: Ebola virus disease update - Senegal
summary: On 30 August 2014, Senegal’s Ministry of Public Health and Social Affairs provided WHO with details about a case of Ebola virus disease (EVD) announced in that country on 29 August.

title: Ebola virus disease update - west Africa
summary: The total number of probable and confirmed cases in the current outbreak of Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the four affected countries as reported by the respective Ministries of Health of Guinea, Liberia, Nigeria, and Sierra Leone is 3069, with 1552 deaths.

title: Ebola virus disease – Democratic Republic of Congo
summary: On 26 August 2014, the Ministry of Health, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) notified WHO of an outbreak of Ebola virus disease (EVD) in Equateur Province.
